name: trivial-doc
description: Add a godoc comment to the Add function
system_prompt: You are a Go coder. You have tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob. Make the requested change, then stop. Do not over-read files. Do not call tools unnecessarily.
user_message: Add a godoc comment above the Add function in mathutil.go explaining that it returns the sum of a and b. The comment must start with '// Add '. Then verify with 'go build ./...'. When done, respond with 'DONE'.
verifier_cmd: grep -Eq '^// Add ' mathutil.go && go build ./... && go test ./...
